# gh-actions

> Shared GitHub Actions and reusable workflows for the ivan-pinatti-labs merge
> pipeline: one configurable implementation of the pin-only diff check and the
> CodeRabbit review verdict, published as composite actions, plus the gate and
> bot auto-merge workflows that use them.
> Apache License 2.0. Author: Ivan Pinatti (https://github.com/ivan-pinatti).
> Canonical repository: https://github.com/ivan-pinatti-labs/gh-actions

## What it does

Six repositories each carried their own copy of `assert-pin-only-diff.py` and
seven carried `coderabbit-review-verdict.py`, roughly 14800 lines maintained in
parallel, and only two of the six tested the pin-only check at all. This
repository holds one implementation of each, with what used to be hardcoded
moved into a YAML configuration and action inputs.

A consumer pins a SHA. A fix here reaches it when Renovate bumps that pin, and
because bumping a pinned `uses:` is itself a pin-only diff, the bot lane
approves and merges it without a person.

## Key files

- [src/pin_only.py](src/pin_only.py): The pin-only diff engine, grammars and configuration
- [src/review_verdict.py](src/review_verdict.py): The `Review Verified` decision
- [pin-only/action.yml](pin-only/action.yml): Composite action wrapping the pin-only check
- [review-verdict/action.yml](review-verdict/action.yml): Composite action wrapping the verdict
- [.github/workflows/reusable-coderabbit-gate.yml](.github/workflows/reusable-coderabbit-gate.yml): The gate, as a reusable workflow
- [examples/](examples/): A configuration per consumer, reproducing its previous script exactly
- [tests/test_equivalence.py](tests/test_equivalence.py): Proves that reproduction, per repository

## Conventions

- Nothing runs on the host. `make test` runs the suite in L2, in a
  devcontainer-airlock workbench.
- Grammars are kept separate rather than converged where two repositories
  behaved differently, because these decide what a dependency bot may merge
  unattended. Converging one is a change with its own test, not a tidy up.
